Results.ReviewText: This is the second Weber we've owned.  Previous one lasted 12 years :)  This performs well and Weber continues to provide great customer service.  Would be over the top if there was a red mark on side of the heat control knobs to line up with the chosen heat setting (omitting the red icon on the face of knobs, which is a distraction.)  Also the larger thermometer with bigger numbers would be an improvement.
Results.Title: Performing well!

Results.ReviewText: I challenge anyone to find another grill company that can match the quality and level of service that Weber offers. My daughter who lives out of town recently blessed me with a new Spirit grill. Unfortunately, during shipping to my house the gas valve got bent. I called Weber to speak about how to purchase a new part and the lady said my grill came with a 10 year warranty so there was no need to purchase anything. They immediately sent my parts out and I had them in hand two days later. I wasn't even charged for shipping. That type of service has become extremely rare, and deserves to be recognized. The Spirit grill is of really high quality, but maybe a touch small for my family of six so I'm working a little OT to save up and buy the Genesis. One thing is for certain, Weber will have to make some big changes if they ever plan to lose my business.
Results.Title: Couldn't be more impressed

Results.ReviewText: Easy to assemble, pretty even heating with no real hot spots, and no flare ups so far.  I have had perfectly cooked burgers, metts, steaks, pork chops, and potatoes.  I will have another test tomorrow with 2.5” sirloin roast for a London broil.  This is my second moderately expensive grill, replacing two consecutive less expensive grills that were both miserable to cook on after a few months and didn’t last as long as my first good quality, non-Weber  grill combined.  I really wanted a smaller grill with three burners and love it.  I do think one higher BTU burner on an  end could be useful.

Results.ReviewText: While I would have preferred to have bought a Genesis level Weber, 10 years ago I purchased my Spirit E-310.  Wow, replace a few parts now and again, and these grills never give out.  It is the perfect grill size for us, with the right features.  Sure, the battery lighter goes out once in awhile, but it is easy to fix.  Keeping it covered has protected the finish, as there are no rust penetrations.  But it stays outside all year and cooks as well in February as in July.  I don't think I will ever need another.  But if I do, it will be a Weber.  I would have replaced any of the other brands at the big box stores 3 times by know.  Weber's last and that makes them a great value.
Results.Title: You only need to buy a Weber Once

Results.ReviewText:
I bought a Weber due to the reputation. The gas Weber we had growing up lasted 20 years without issue. After 5 years with my Spirit, I would say I am not terribly impressed with the longevity. Granted, this is an entry level grill, but being a Weber, I expected more. My grill is always covered with a heavy duty grill cover. My experience:

- The cart is garbage. It began showing signs of corrosion after 1.5 years. It's trying to rust away to nothing. I've had to treat and paint the cart a couple of times.
- The cast iron grates began to rust after 3 years. I got a warranty replacement set and will try to be gentler on them. 
- The heating is uneven. Has been uneven since nearly the beginning. 
- The stainless parts need to be polished a lot. Surface rust is common. 
- Firebox is fine, although the finish around the edges are starting to peel.
Results.Title: 5 years with the Weber Spirit.

ClientResponses.Response: We greatly appreciate your feedback. We are so sorry to learn of your experience with the Spirit E-310 grill. This is not the quality we expect from our products. Please be on the look out for an outreach email from our Support team. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Bought this grill less than 2 years ago and parts are rusting. I have reached out to customer service via email and every time they respond its a different person and seems that they never read the chain of email. Photos and video have been emailed and did not receive a reply back after showing damaged parts with rust. Flavorizer  bars are extremely rusted and lasted less than 2 years. Grill grate has started to rust along with other parts. Burners won't ignite with battery ignitor and have to use match or lighter. When grilling and having all three burners on (ignited) there is times wind will blow out one burner and won't ignite again on its own. It's frustrating to he checking my grill for blow outs and having the fear of creating a gas cloud and having and explosion. I have to re-ignite the burner with a lighter when it blows out. Burners have been clean and still have same issue.
Results.Title: Poor customer service

Results.ReviewText: Love my Weber E-310 as Grill, but the cap that holds the battery for the electronic igniter broke. I need a new LITTLE CAP!!! After reaching out to Weber, I have received every part, EXCEPT the little cap!!!! Help ME! I am now using long matches to light my grill, Electronic igniter will not work without the cap.
Results.Title: Battery Cap Broke

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
